g.title: wav, mp3, flac, ogg or mp4 recordings from any source. Real corpora are full of silence, hiss, clipping, test tones and phone-line audio.

The aerosieve binary, built with clap. curate writes shards and prints rejection counts by reason. inspect prints one verdict per clip and writes nothing. --policy loads threshold overrides from JSON. Both are thin front ends over Pipeline and Inspector.

PyO3 and wasm-bindgen bindings: bindings/python (inspect and curate, built with maturin) and bindings/wasm (the browser demo). They take files or bytes and call Inspector. The WASM build decodes and scores once, then re-applies a policy to stored measurements on every slider move.

Symphonia decodes any container it can read, then the audio is downmixed, resampled to 16 kHz with rubato and levelled in RMS toward -20 dBFS within 3 dB. It keeps the applied gain so full_scale() can recover the source's own peak.
